title: Vintage 1970's Coca-Cola Glasses Tiffany Style Tumbler Drinking Set Of 2
descriptionText: This vintage set of 1970's Coca-Cola glasses features a Tiffany style design with a clear glass material. The set includes two tumblers, making it perfect for enjoying your favorite beverages in a nostalgic and stylish way. Ideal for collectors or those looking to add a unique touch to their barware collection, these glasses offer a retro charm that is sure to stand out.
